explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/801 (proved by Alon): if an n-vertex G has no independent set of more than n^{1/2} vertices, there is a set of ≤ n^{1/2} vertices spanning ≫ n^{1/2} log n edges. The statement asserts c > 0 such that, for large n, α(G) ≤ √n implies some S with |S| ≤ √n and ≥ c√n log n edges in G[S]. Faithful.
